summary: Official warnings for Baloxavir Marboxil include severe allergic reactions such as anaphylaxis, swelling beneath the skin called angioedema, hives called urticaria, and a skin reaction known as erythema multiforme [3]. An additional warning notes an increased occurrence of the virus becoming resistant to treatment in children younger than five years old [3]. Based on a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received a high risk score of 67 for the liver and a low risk score of 44 for the heart [M].
